title: Costs of a special pay plan.
bodyText: Costs associated with the implementation and administration of a special pay plan established pursuant to this chapter shall be borne by the selected plan provider.
bodyHtml: [§88D-5]  Costs of a special pay plan.  Costs associated with the implementation and administration of a special pay plan established pursuant to this chapter shall be borne by the selected plan provider. [L 2003, c 109, pt of §2]
